sourceIncident.course: Research Methods in the Social Sciences
sourceIncident.visibleFailure: Course map generation stopped at 11 of 12 lessons.

rootCause.summary: The model returned useful new lessons on both continuations, but the course-map loop had a fixed maximum of two continuation attempts and stopped one lesson early.
rootCause.dataLossRisk: A terminal throw discarded the useful eleven-lesson partial map from the user-visible build.
rootCause.classificationDefect: An explicit incomplete-map quality condition was classified as unknown and non-retryable.

fixes: Public Scion continuation budget is derived from remaining lesson scope and capped at twelve attempts.
Every accepted lesson preserves progress; two consecutive no-progress responses terminate bounded recovery.
Accepted continuation output is sliced to the remaining requested lesson scope.
Cloud-provider course-map continuation retains its existing two-attempt policy.
Incomplete X-of-Y course maps are classified as retryable quality failures.
Captured compact-wire splices are repaired before raw field keys can enter visible lesson prose.
Qualitative research coding and optional Python notebooks no longer misclassify a research-methods course as a programming lab.
Research-method citations, weekly-assessment alignment, FAQ technical-help variation, speaker notes, and study-guide transfer language are calibrated at compiler and grader boundaries.
ZIP assembly yields a visible preparing frame and exposes aria-busy state before synchronous archive work.

exactBrowserReplay.brief: Research Methods in the Social Sciences, 12-week graduate seminar with scaffolded proposal milestones, peer review workshops, mixed-methods labs, and a final research design portfolio. Covers qualitative and quantitative approaches, sampling, survey design, interviews, focus groups, observation, research ethics, mixed-methods integration, data analysis, and proposal development.
